# AI Voiceover Studio

> AI Voiceover Studio (`ai-voiceover-studio`, command `voiceover`) is an open-source MIT-licensed Python 3.9+ CLI and library that turns a Markdown script into an AI voiceover, SRT subtitles and a captioned faceless video (Ken Burns slides, cross-fades, styled burned-in captions) for YouTube, Shorts and explainers. It works out of the box with free Microsoft Edge neural voices (no account, no API key); Miragea (https://miragea.ai) adds voice cloning and expressive voices; an OpenAI engine and an offline dummy engine are also built in.

Key facts:
- Quickstart: `git clone https://github.com/yanghhu/ai-voiceover-studio && cd ai-voiceover-studio`, `pip install -e ".[edge]"`, `voiceover video --images examples/slides --script examples/script.md -o out/video.mp4`. Needs ffmpeg (with libass); `voiceover doctor` checks the setup.
- Engines: `edge` (free, default without MIRAGEA_API_KEY, 322 voices / 75 languages, extra `[edge]`), `miragea` (MIRAGEA_API_KEY; voice cloning from a reference URL, expressive models, subtitle recognition; default when the key is set), `openai` (OPENAI_API_KEY), `dummy` (`--dry-run`, offline). Select with `--provider` or `VOICEOVER_PROVIDER`.
- Commands: `voiceover say "text" [--voice ID|URL] -o out.mp3`; `voiceover script script.md [--voices voices.json] -o out/`; `voiceover video [--images dir/] --script script.md -o video.mp4 [--style clean|box|bold|minimal] [--size 1080x1920] [--speaker-labels]`; `voiceover voices [--provider edge --filter en-GB]`; `voiceover doctor [--online]`; `voiceover task <id> --wait` (Miragea). `--json` gives machine-readable output.
- Script format: `[SPEAKER]: text` lines in Markdown/TXT, untagged lines continue the speaker, `[pause 1.5]` inserts silence, `[SPEAKER](tags=a|b, speed=1.1): ...` sets per-line options. Speakers without a configured voice get distinct voices automatically.
- Outputs: audio track (MP3/WAV), SRT (timed from engine sentence boundaries or segment durations, or speech recognition), per-segment cache, manifest.json, MP4.
- Reliability: per-line cache, deterministic idempotency keys, async task polling (Miragea), retries only on retryable errors, keys never printed or stored. Core has zero third-party dependencies.
- Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex / Cursor: skills/ai-voiceover/SKILL.md.
